name: Mastering Type
description: The tenth anniversary edition of Mastering Type presents outstanding typeface designs from international master's programs over the past decade. The pop-up exhibition at the Kulturforum features approximately 350 new typefaces created since 2016, displayed on individual posters alongside Process Books offering insights into conceptualization and creative processes. The exhibition hall transforms into a walk-in, three-dimensional typographic space. Includes a series of lectures and workshops on April 25, 2026.
